request.expected_result: Exit 0 and status passed only with exactly 384 real MMIO comparisons all equal, 16 original BRAM words fully restored and read back equal, observed reset direction/value and prior export state restored, and no errors. On an initially unexported GPIO, initial reset means the observation after this run exports it; pre-export output latch remains unknown. Any missing evidence, mismatch, exception or unverified cleanup yields nonzero exit and failed status. No optical GPIO, synthesis or prior-overlay restoration claim.
test_steps: Only A current Desktop board owner: check out the exact PR head, verify this manifest and source/evidence hashes, and serialize use of the base overlay and iop_pmoda BRAM. No background board dispatch and no GPIO v1 execution. This revision supersedes the earlier base-bram-v2 handoff for future execution; do not run both. Preserve any actual earlier result under its original identity.

Use A already-authorized root login shell with BOARD=Pynq-Z2, XILINX_XRT=/usr and cwd=/tmp; interpreter /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3, imported PYNQ from its venv. Transfer the exact reviewed examples/board_collaboration/base_bram_board_test.py bytes.

Run once: /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3 base_bram_board_test.py --bitstream /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/pynq/overlays/base/base.bit --output base-bram-v2-reset-origin-r1-result.json --operation-id BOARD-20261013-A:B:base-bram-v2-reset-origin-r1 --request-hash <this manifest request_hash> --code-commit 3f9e9a52c950c0bbac24675e7fb49c8fe46a50c7 --tested-commit <exact PR head SHA>. Output must not exist. Preserve stdout, stderr and exit code.

Before one Overlay load, verify bit SHA256 ecabdcb5d483c75335ab6f043824a2386971c7b0ffd6e3315f24860bf5088eb6 and hwh SHA256 cbd90c84f3a46d1eba95dff7ba7d0079812f7e46641a08e2318c9928cd36ce8f. Record PL identity before/after; unknown pre-load identity is not a restored prior configuration.

Validate overlay.ip_dict iop_pmoda/mb_bram_ctrl as xilinx.com:ip:axi_bram_ctrl:4.1, base 0x40000000 and range 0x10000; derive MMIO from that metadata. Validate mb_iop_pmoda_reset GPIO index 0 and derive Linux GPIO via GPIO.get_gpio_pin (A observed 960). If absent, export only this resolved GPIO. Record direction/value observed after export, with observation_point=post_load_post_export_sysfs_observation and pre_export_output_latch_known=false; no pre-export invisible latch claim. For an existing export, record post_load_existing_export_sysfs_observation. Set direction=high and confirm reset high via fresh sysfs reads.

Snapshot all 16 uint32 words at offsets 0xFC00..0xFC3C. For each of 3 rounds, write all 16 before reading all 16 for each batch: 0, FFFFFFFF, 55555555, AAAAAAAA, A5A50000|index, its uint32 inverse, 1<<index, and 16 getrandbits(32) values from Random(0x20261013), same vector each round. Record all 384 expected/observed values and physical sources.

Finally, hold reset high and restore every captured word, attempting all writes and all readbacks. Only after all 16 are verified, restore the reset value/direction observed during snapshot preparation; then unexport only if this run exported the GPIO. If BRAM restoration is unverified, retain reset high, report failure and request A recovery; do not silently release or automatically rerun.

A posts operation_id, request_hash, actual tested_commit, runtime versions, command, exit code and public JSON/stdout/stderr paths with SHA256 on this PR. A decides hardware acceptance against these measured results.
